cases.title: AnalysisScope / ResultEnvelope consistency and stale generation rejection
cases.precondition: Temporary dev root with the M1 AC-02 fixture library; AppHost started.
steps: Run the same scoped query twice through AppHost and once through the AI tool gateway.
Send a request with an unknown scope, an unpublished dataset_version and a stale generation.
Freeze an empty account scope and dataset_version 0, then add accounts and market data; verify the snapshot never expands.
cases.expected: All three results are field-for-field identical (values, quality, evidence refs, versions); invalid scope/version/generation are rejected with structured errors. Frozen empty members and version 0 remain empty; unsupported old ledger revisions are rejected rather than silently replaced.

cases.title: Schema 4 migration with automatic pre-migration backup
cases.precondition: A schema 3 library produced by the M1 code path.
steps: Open with M2 code to trigger migration; verify a consistent backup exists before migration.
Inject a failure mid-migration and reopen.
Re-run migration on the migrated library.
cases.expected: Backup restores to an identical schema 3 library; failed migration leaves no half-written database; migration is idempotent.

cases.title: Thin slice M2-K01: headless overview shows AC-02 results; desktop dependency boundary
cases.precondition: gpui-kit test-support headless window; AppHost on the AC-02 fixture library.
steps: Open the workbench headless and render the overview.
Read MetricCard values for cash, NAV and total P&L.
Assert cargo metadata direct dependencies of delta-desktop exclude delta-data, rusqlite, tokio and reqwest.
cases.expected: Cards show cash 1438, NAV 2068, total P&L 68 with currency and quality badge; boundary check passes; 0 visible windows during the test.

cases.title: Accounts, portfolios and scoped period P&L breakdown
cases.precondition: Fixture with two accounts, an internal transfer of 1000 with fee 2, and the AC-07 inflow case.
steps: Create a portfolio containing both accounts and another where one account is reachable through overlapping groups.
Query period breakdown per account, per portfolio and for the whole library.
cases.expected: Portfolio view: transfer creates no return, fee P&L -2; single account treats it as external flow; AC-07 period P&L 0; no double counting; breakdown components sum to the period change or show unattributed items with reasons; basic drawdown has an explicit status.

cases.title: Missing price / FX / cost, manual valuations and stale reports
cases.precondition: Fixture with a missing price day, missing FX, unknown opening cost, a manual asset valuation and a later amendment.
steps: Query overview and breakdown.
Amend a booked trade, then reopen the earlier saved report.
cases.expected: Known-part valuation shown with excluded items; affected metrics unavailable (never 0); manual valuation shows date and method; earlier report flagged stale with a recompute entry.

cases.title: LEDGER-01 cash exchange USD -> USDT -> BTC
cases.precondition: Account with USD cash; exchange to USDT with fee; buy BTC with USDT; sell part back.
steps: Import or record the chain.
Query holdings, cash by currency, realized and FX results.
cases.expected: USDT acquired via exchange settles the quote leg exactly once; quantities and costs reconcile across three assets; exchange cost and FX gain/loss recorded; no double deduction.

cases.title: First run, settings and import preview UI (headless)
cases.precondition: Empty temporary dev root; Futu and generic CSV fixtures including a held row and a duplicate file.
steps: Complete the first-run wizard by keyboard: create library, set report currency and timezone, add account.
Import a CSV: inspect raw rows, normalized values, errors, suspected duplicates; resolve a held row; commit.
Re-import the same file; restart and check settings.
Click actual account/import controls; modify a previewed file before commit and verify rejection; preserve unsubmitted settings and model inputs during background refresh.
cases.expected: Preview matches host-rebuilt data; commit is transactional; re-import prompts already imported; settings persist; changing report currency does not alter raw events.

cases.title: Data center sync job progress, cancel and failure states
cases.precondition: Loopback provider fixtures for success, rate limit, auth failure, truncated JSON and slow response.
steps: Start a sync job from the data center and observe progress.
Cancel mid-run; run each failure fixture.
cases.expected: Coverage, source, update time, adjustment and gaps visible; cancel acknowledged in UI within 1 s and job terminal within 5 s; failures show cause and next action; watermark advances only after commit; no failed job marked success. Prepared/published counts and phase are actual; cancellation drops an in-flight slow provider request and worker_finished proves lease release.

cases.title: Asset views: holdings, FIFO lots, flows, reconciliation and drill-down
cases.precondition: AC-02 and AC-05 fixtures; a manual balance snapshot that differs from the ledger.
steps: Open the assets page; inspect lots after the partial sell and after the 2:1 split with dividend.
Enter a manual balance snapshot; drill from overview P&L to flows.
cases.expected: Remaining quantity 6, cost 600.6, realized 38.6 match; split keeps total cost; dividend counted once; reconciliation shows ledger / snapshot / difference / time without auto-adjusting; drill-down keeps scope and filters.

cases.title: KlineViewport, indicators across windows and future sentinel
cases.precondition: Synthetic 100,000 daily bars with a sentinel extreme value after visible_until; a gap and a half-day session.
steps: Zoom, pan, jump to date and move the crosshair via KlineViewport unit tests.
Compute MA/EMA/MACD/RSI for two different windows covering the same date.
Search an instrument by alias and add it to a watchlist group.
Simulate actual mouse movement, wheel zoom, marker click and Escape; vary cached content and indicator configuration at the same dates.
cases.expected: Same-date indicator values identical across windows; warm-up empty; sentinel never affects visible indicators or markers; gaps shown as gaps; adjustment/timezone/stale/incomplete flags displayed; venue vs pair distinguished in search.

cases.title: Trade/note markers and chart context round trip
cases.precondition: A plan linked to several adds/reduces; a note with a saved chart context and a pinned dataset_version.
steps: Click a trade marker and a note marker (headless).
From the note jump back to the chart.
Amend a linked trade.
cases.expected: Markers open the right records; returning restores instrument/venue/timeframe/window/adjustment/indicators with the anchor near centre; linked quantities never exceed fills; amended link shows a notice; latest-vs-pinned data difference is prompted. Scope validates every linked account/event/chart anchor/review date; saved chart viewport and indicator parameters survive round trips.

cases.title: Notes: autosave honesty, templates, tags, search and attachments
cases.precondition: Notes with pre/during/post templates, Chinese and English text, an attachment; a storage fault injector.
steps: Edit and wait for autosave; inject a write failure and retry.
Kill the host mid-edit and reopen.
Search 1-, 2- and 3+-character Chinese queries and an English query; remove an attachment file on disk.
Continue typing while a save is in flight; switch scope with a dirty buffer and inject failure; verify owner/review_date and historical cutoff, including saved_at, with bounded search warnings.
cases.expected: Status transitions editing -> saving -> saved; failure keeps the buffer and never shows saved; recovery to the last persisted revision; search results correct with the documented short-query fallback; missing attachment detected. Failed scope-switch save retains old scope and buffer; late save receipts do not replace new input; review date and real save time have separate visibility rules; optimistic conflicts leave no partial links.

cases.title: ModelClient: Responses and Chat Completions on a loopback server
cases.precondition: Loopback server bound to 127.0.0.1:0 replaying official wire-format samples for both protocols.
steps: Run text streaming, split tool-call arguments, tool pairing, normal terminal events, truncated stream, 401/403, 429 with Retry-After, cancel during stream.
Configure an unknown protocol.
cases.expected: Both adapters pass the full set independently; partial streams marked incomplete and not replayed after visible output; no retry on 401/403; bounded retries on 429/5xx; cancel releases resources; unknown protocol rejected without fallback.

cases.title: AI review: AC-02 Q&A, evidence and number verification, injection and forged citations
cases.precondition: Scripted loopback model; AC-02 library; a note containing instructions to read other accounts; an unauthorized account with matching trades.
steps: Ask for the AC-02 P&L explanation.
Let the scripted model cite a non-existent object and include a number absent from tool receipts.
Process the injection note.
Reject non-JSON or empty citations, Chinese/fullwidth/signed unmatched numbers and forged prose citations; verify equivalent numeric formats and truncated detail projection evidence.
cases.expected: Answer shows 68 with components and openable evidence; forged citation blocked; unmatched number marks the report needs_review; scope and tools never widen; the unauthorized account never appears; send scope (accounts, period, notes) visible before sending.

cases.title: Sessions, atomic compaction, recovery, cancel and late events
cases.precondition: Multi-turn session with tool receipts; fault injection during compaction; scope and model switch.
steps: Trigger compaction and inject a failure; restart and resume.
Switch account scope and model; deliver a late event from the old generation.

Use the same connection ID in two libraries under one test credential namespace; verify secrets remain independent, blank edits retain authentication, restart restores settings, failed saves restore the previous secret and missing entries can be reconfigured.
cases.expected: Failed compaction keeps the previous checkpoint; resumed run keeps the frozen scope and citations; switches start a new run; stale generation events are dropped; nothing marked success without a terminal state. Full connection and journal fingerprints guard raw history and compaction; old reports and receipts remain subject to current permissions.

cases.title: Local features without a model
cases.precondition: No model connection configured; then a configured but unreachable endpoint.
steps: Use overview, assets, chart and notes; open the AI panel; request a report.
cases.expected: All local features work; the AI panel explains the missing/unreachable model with retry; existing reports stay readable.

cases.title: Backup, restore, export and delete including notes, attachments and AI sessions; log redaction
cases.precondition: Library with ledger, notes, attachments, chart contexts and AI sessions; log capture enabled.
steps: Create a backup and restore into a new directory.
Export ledger CSV/JSON, notes Markdown, attachments, settings and data manifest.
Preview and execute library deletion.
Scan logs.

Change the deletion identity after preview and verify refusal; validate all uninstall hashes before mutation; attempt installed self-uninstall and preserve unknown files; scan unknown secrets and note fragments without echoing them.
Parse normal and delay-load PE imports; reject external MSVC runtimes, malformed RVAs and truncated binaries; exercise packaged CLI installation and external uninstall for both static-CRT channels.
cases.expected: Restore verifies ledger/note/attachment references; export complete and open-format; deletion scope shown and no dangling references; logs contain no secrets, full account numbers or note bodies; dev channel cannot target release roots. Deletion checks manifest/database identity and closes resources; audit logs contain only allowlisted metadata; leak diagnostics do not repeat sensitive values; external backups and model retention are outside local deletion.

cases.title: M1 regression through the M2 workspace
cases.precondition: M2 workspace build.
steps: Run the M1 named test mapping inside verify-stage --stage M2.
cases.expected: All M1 required cases pass with the M2 schema and calculation version.

cases.title: Dependency lock and license inventory for distribution
cases.precondition: Product Cargo.lock including gpui-kit and delta-model dependencies.
steps: Generate the per-package license inventory from cargo metadata --locked.
Check MPL-2.0 and multi-license selections and notice files.
cases.expected: Every locked package has an exact SPDX OR selection with all AND obligations retained; original notices and hashes are collected. Missing original texts are labelled as pinned SPDX standard text plus complete locked source archive, with attribution and source identities; all are bundled.

cases.title: Fixed-scale performance benchmarks (explicit --ui-bench)
cases.precondition: Release build; 100,000 transactions; 100,000 daily bars; recorded hardware.
steps: Run the real release desktop artifact in hidden native Windows windows, recording GPU/CPU, DPI, dimensions, source fingerprint and actual paint/cell counts.

Measure 5 fresh-process AC-02 first screens from Rust entry (including fixture setup; excluding OS loader; caches are not flushed), and 300 navigation actions through persistence and native paint (including observer interval).

Measure 100,000-row DataTable scrolling and 100,000 daily bars with 1,000 visible bars: 20 warm-up and 300 measured frames per component, update through WM_PAINT and render/present calls, excluding idle timers.
Measure controlled cancellation acknowledgment and actual worker release; separately verify in-flight provider cancellation; recalculate p50/p95/p99 from raw samples.
cases.expected: Required samples, frame/cell counts and release build are verified. First screen P95 <=3 s, navigation P95 <=100 ms, frame P95 <=20 ms, cancel acknowledgment <=1 s / worker release <=5 s. Viewport-only timing cannot pass native frame acceptance. Missing explicit UI checks are not-run; unmet targets fail. Hidden-window frame budgets are not a visible-display FPS trace.

cases.title: Chinese IME composition (H-01)
cases.precondition: Installed dev build; Microsoft Pinyin or another Chinese IME.
steps: Type Chinese in notes, search and import mapping fields with candidate selection; press Enter during composition.
cases.expected: Composition never commits or submits prematurely; text correct; recorded with IME name and version.

cases.title: Keyboard, focus, Esc, 125%/150% scaling, small window and colour convention (H-02)
cases.precondition: Installed dev build on Windows 11 at 100%, 125% and 150% scaling.
steps: Navigate all pages, tables, chart controls and dialogs by keyboard; resize to a small window; switch the colour convention.
cases.expected: All in-scope actions reachable; focus visible and kept; Esc consistent; long numbers and key actions not clipped; up/down shown with sign and text.

cases.title: Clean-machine per-user install, channel coexistence and uninstall (H-03)
cases.precondition: Clean Windows 11 VM or Windows Sandbox without Rust/MSVC/Python developer tools or a separately installed VC redistributable.
steps: Install release and dev packages without admin; run offline; uninstall one channel.
cases.expected: Installs under LOCALAPPDATA Programs as delta and delta-dev; both run side by side with separate data; the app works offline; uninstall keeps application data.

cases.title: Public market data probes regression (--live)
cases.precondition: Network access through the configured exit; public endpoints only.
steps: Run verify-stage --stage M2 --live.
cases.expected: Same public probe assertions as M1 pass or are reported with the actual HTTP status; private services not-run.

cases.title: Real model service for the user-configured protocol (ACT-01)
cases.precondition: User-provided model connection via ACT-01 stored in keyring; explicit budget.
steps: Connectivity and capability check; one AC-02 review question with tools; cancel one request.
cases.expected: Only the configured protocol/model is claimed; tool pairing, streaming terminal state and cancel verified; otherwise not-run.
